label: Esse-cause efficiency controls: non-efficient cause, restricted bridge, nonvacuity
paraphrase: Closed finite controls on interpretations over Bool (two beings, two principles, one respect), in each of which false actually exists with esse distinct from its essence and true does not. (1) Non-efficient cause: true, in act, causes false's esse and nothing is an efficient cause of anything; the q.3 a.4 dichotomy and no-essential-self-sufficiency, no self-causation, the actuality of causes of being, the mode-unspecified q.3 a.4 conclusion (STMT-DISTINCT-ESSE-REQUIRES-EXTERNAL-CAUSE) and the De ente conclusion (457698e4) all hold, while the restricted and unrestricted efficiency bridges and the efficient conclusion fail. 'Non-efficient' is a label: EfficientlyCausesEsse is an unconstrained primitive, so this shows that the efficient conclusion does not follow from the mode-unspecified ones without a bridge, not that a non-efficient cause of esse is possible. (2) Restricted bridge only: true efficiently causes false's esse and false causes true's esse non-efficiently; the restricted bridge holds and the unrestricted one fails. (3) Nonvacuity: true efficiently causes false's esse; every input of both efficient-cause derivations, both bridges and the efficient conclusion hold.
